african-official.note: African countries only, and only languages indigenous to Africa (Afrikaans and the African creoles included; Arabic, English, French, Portuguese and Spanish left out). Eritrea's nine equal languages, Benin's, Togo's, Guinea's national languages and Ghana's government-sponsored languages were added by hand.

living-scripts.note: Only scripts in use today (Unicode's recommended and limited-use scripts, plus scripts with living liturgical or heritage use such as Coptic, Samaritan, Nüshu and Dongba); Braille, the IPA, SignWriting and shorthand added by hand.

constructed-languages.note: Fictional languages well known from books, films and games (Parseltongue, Minionese, Hylian and others) added by hand; language games such as Pig Latin left out.
